errors.error_description: Drove an input port from within the module using a continuous assignment (assign wr_en = 1'b0;), violating port direction rules.
Implemented next-count computation with an unnecessarily deep nested if-else chain on a simple condition, creating a long combinational path that is suboptimal for synthesis.
Created an unintended latch by assigning dout_next only under a condition in an always_comb without providing a default or else branch.
